research.title: Gemini Robotics 2 expands embodied intelligence
research.description: Google DeepMind describes Gemini Robotics 2 as a VLA model for robot action, with whole-body control, dexterity and multi-robot collaboration capabilities.
research.label: Google DeepMind · Jul 2026

research.title: World Action Models emerge beyond traditional VLA
research.description: NVIDIA describes World Action Models as jointly learning future world states and robot actions, extending the physical reasoning stack beyond direct VLA action prediction.
research.label: NVIDIA · 2026

research.title: Physical AI stack expands across simulation, models and deployment
research.description: NVIDIA's 2026 robotics materials connect simulation, robot learning, foundation models and edge deployment into a broader physical-AI development stack.
research.label: NVIDIA · 2026

timeline.title: Gemini Robotics enters the physical world
timeline.description: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics as a vision-language-action model and Gemini Robotics-ER for embodied reasoning.

timeline.title: Open models, evaluation and training infrastructure expand
timeline.description: NVIDIA announces new Cosmos and GR00T models, Isaac Lab-Arena evaluation, OSMO and open robotics integrations.

timeline.title: Physical AI moves toward production-scale deployment
timeline.description: NVIDIA describes an ecosystem spanning robot brains, world models, simulation and industrial deployment, including FieldAI, Skild AI and World Labs.

timeline.title: Cosmos 3 unifies reasoning, world generation and action prediction
timeline.description: NVIDIA launches Cosmos 3 as an open physical AI foundation model for reasoning, world simulation and action generation.

timeline.title: Whole-body intelligence reaches humanoids
timeline.description: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics 2, Gemini Robotics ER 2 and On-Device 2, covering whole-body control, embodied reasoning and local execution.
